primitives.name: Fractional-Kelly Drawdown Governor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Fractional-Kelly + drawdown governor + decorrelated book (evidence: medium) **Basis:** 1210 (full-Kelly ruin), 1628 (M(k) governor), 0174 (γ=0.4 decorrelation).
primitives.latex: f_{\text{Kelly}} = \frac{bp - q}{b}, \quad f_{\text{scaled}} = \gamma \cdot f_{\text{Kelly}}, \quad D(t) = \max_{\tau \leq t} \left( \frac{V(t) - V(\tau)}{V(\tau)} \right)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'b': 'net odds received on the bet', 'p': 'probability of winning', 'q': 'probability of losing', '\\gamma': 'fractional Kelly coefficient (γ ≈ 0.4)', 'D(t)': 'drawdown at time t', 'V(t)': 'portfolio value at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: Portfolio allocation based on fractional Kelly; drawdown governed by M(k) rule; decorrelation via γ-weighted strategy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Single-episode governance; decorrelation may deviate from theoretical model.

layer2.mapping: GSE uses M(k) drawdown governor to prevent full-Kelly ruin while applying decorrelated book logic.
layer2.telemetry: Drawdown percentage, Kelly fraction, and decorrelation coefficient γ.

reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives form a layered system where calibration-first selection ensures reliable model ranking, followed by fractional Kelly sizing that mitigates ruin via drawdown governors and decorrelation. Edge decay monitoring provides diagnostic feedback on signal longevity, while OL degradation triggers pressure funnel detection. These components interact through shared data streams: model probabilities inform Kelly sizing, which feeds into drawdown tracking; edge decay alerts influence model re-ranking; and pressure funnels provide situational context for decision-making. Dualities emerge in how reliability and risk management interplay—calibration ensures trustworthiness, while Kelly controls exposure. Failure modes include over-reliance on single-season tuning, misapplication of pseudo-counts, and lack of joint behavior testing. The system must balance empirical fidelity with adaptability to evolving conditions.
